findings.quote: The light was starting to change color, though. It was still afternoon, still hours of daylight left, but the quality of it was shifting. Golden instead of white.
findings.claim: The third statement that the light is changing, after the sun s slow tilt west and the bright hammer of midday going golden. It stops the climb dead.
findings.fix: Cut it and keep the long shadows line, which is a physical effect and does new work.

findings.quote: his ears had stayed happy all the way up, and they stayed happy now
findings.claim: stayed happy twice inside eleven words; read aloud it stutters

iterations.notes: both findings resolved and no new defect created. The critic checked the two risks the patches introduced - a paragraph left hollow by the cut, and Rosa saying tomorrow twice - and found the first reads naturally into the shadow image and the second sits in character within her fast rambling speech.
